calculatorhorror.configuration.title: Calculator (Horror) Configs
calculatorhorror.warning.title: Calculator (Horror) - Before You Continue
calculatorhorror.warning.body.intro: This mod can, at any time and without further warning:
calculatorhorror.warning.body.line1: - Teleport you anywhere, including to other dimensions (such as the End)
calculatorhorror.warning.body.line2: - Apply or remove potion effects on you
calculatorhorror.warning.body.line3: - Read, add, or remove items in your inventory, ender chest, or nearby containers
calculatorhorror.warning.body.line5: - Force-respawn you, even if you are not dead
calculatorhorror.warning.body.line6: - Play sounds that only you can hear
calculatorhorror.warning.body.line7: - Make chunks near you visually vanish or reappear (a rendering trick only - the world itself is unaffected)
calculatorhorror.warning.body.line8: - Send chat messages, including fake "player joined" messages and tab-list entries for players who do not actually exist
calculatorhorror.warning.body.line9: - Place or change blocks in the world
calculatorhorror.warning.body.outro: None of this is a bug - it is how this mod's horror effects work. Do not continue if you are not comfortable with any of the above.
calculatorhorror.warning.checkbox: I have read this and agree to continue
